tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus mdos zor las pa'i nyer mkho'i yi ge bzhugs so// dge legs 'phel/ oṃ swasti/ byang phyogs bstan pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed srol 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub bgrang yas kyang / /thun mong min pa'i dgongs pa 'grel mkhas pa/ /kun dga' blo gros zhabs pad gtsug na rgyal/ /'dir gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos chen mo'i zor las pa nyer mkho cung zad brjod na/ de yang zor las pa rnams bla med kyi rgyud sde/ khyad par kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing / gzhi bsnyen sbyin sreg mthar phyin pa zhig gi chos skyong so so'i gzhi bsnyen song ba'am ma song yang rung ste/ gtor ma'i las sgrub pa'i sngon du sgrub bsnyen mdor bsdus bya tshul ni/ thun bzhi la bsngo ba'am dam tshig lnga/ dgong thun la bskang ba byed pa spro na bskram bskang thun gtor bcas/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa phud chang / thun so so la gso ba'i mtheb kyu/ rdor dril sogs nyer mkho tshang ma bshams la/ mtshams bcas te/ zhag bdun gyi ring thun bcad du sgrub te/ de yang zhugs pa'i dgong thun dang / srod thun de'i sang nas bzung thun bzhi/ dus mdos tshugs rgyu'i snga dro thun gcig rnams bdag bskyed lam dus thun bzhi kyai rdor gzhi bsnyen bzhin/ thun mtshams thams cad la gtor bsngo chen mo byas nas/ yig brgya dang de wa pi tsu ci rigs bzlas la/ mgon chen gyis des thun gyi dngos gzhi mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma khri sogs bzlas na/ lha mo'i ro rū lnga stong tsam/ zhal gyi des thun re la zhal gyi sngags thung ci 'grub/ spro zhing shes na sngags ring kyang 'phreng skor tsam/ pu tra'i des thun re la las mkhan mo'i 'bod pa stong bzlas na/ pho'i 'bod pa a li lnga brgya/ bdud rgyal nges/ dkar bdud sngags sgrub kyi sngags ci sgrub/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor des shā sa na kho na bzla/ sngags gzhan rnams rgyun gtor bsngo bzhin/

mchod pa 'phrin bcol bshags pa/ tho snga srod gsum gyi thun la lcam bral zhal gyi sngags thung sngon 'gro'i bstod pa/ rdor glu bkra shis/ smon lam/ spyi btab/ srid zhi dpal 'byor/ gzhug chog rnams rgyun bzhin/ dgong thun la dril bsil ma'am/ rnga brdung gang rung gi bskang ba bcas bgyi rgyu 'di ni sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag len lhad med yin/ ces shes na ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam rgyal skor gsum dang / bdag chen kha'u pas rten dang mchod gtor bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag gi yi ge dang mthun pa'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas grangs ci rigs thim nas/ dus mdos dngos gzhi'i tshe thor thun gong bzhin dang snga thun dang dgong thun gnyis tshogs pa dang mnyam du byas pa des go chod la/ nyer gsum nas nyer brgyad bar gyi srod thun dang / nyer bzhi nas nyer dgu'i bar gyi thor thun tshoms chen rang du mdzad srol 'dug pas dam rdzas gnyis dang rgyag gtor bskang gtor dung gi mchod pa rnams kha bsos/ thor thun la 'bul rgyu'i zor las pa lnga'i thun gtor thun mong du grangs gang rung gi gcig srod thun gyi thun gtor ni mgyogs gtor bshams par sbyangs bdug bya'o/ /srod thun gyi spyi btab ran pa dang / thun gtor phyir rkang gling g.yab dar phud chang bcas khyer nas/ mgon po'i man ngag dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa mon bu pu tra gnas nas bskyod/ zhes sogs pu tra bskul dang / spyi btab 'bul sngags phud chang 'thor ba dang bcas pas mgyogs gtor de bsngos la/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gsol ba'i lhag ma dug dang mtshon cha sogs su dmigs nas zor bya ba yin pas/ de'i phyir dus gsum rgyal ba'i drag bskul pho nya bskul rnams byas nas bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rang rang gi sngags bzlas pa'i mthar suṃ trig rakṣa sogs thun sngags dang / bha ya na mo pa dang bcas pa brjod nas/

lag 'gyang 'phen pa ltar shugs skyed de dor ba las chos 'byung sogs 'bri mi dgos/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku thog la sku mtshams kyi ring kyang dgong thun gsung bskang gi thun gtor de mchod g.yog rkang gling dang bcas pas shā sa na bzlas bzhin par smad/ zhing nas 'phangs tshul rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtshor gsal/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi gser skyems/ dpang gzugs zor lam dbye ba pho nya bskul/ chos 'byung bris nas 'phangs pa 'di zor rgyas pa'i phyag len 'dra yang kho bo ni khyer bde don tshang bla ma gong ma'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /nang du log nas srid zhi dpal 'byor sogs mjug chog rnams bya/ dngos gzhi'i zor gtor lnga po 'di 'phangs ma ran gyi bar la gtor bsngo'i skabs su sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag du bsam pa'i bstod de gtor ma'i dbyibs su bsam nas 'bul ba yin/ gtso gtor lcam dral gnyis thun mong / g.yas gtor zhal gtso 'khor lnga 'khor bcas/ g.yon gtor las mgon lnga/ gdong ma bzhi/ pho nya lnga/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa rgyud gsum sogs pho nya spyi gtor/ g.yas gtor gnyis pa dkar bdud phur srung / g.yon gtor gnyis pa mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ mkha' 'gro'i sde lnga sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma thun mong des gong gi dam rdzas gnyis ni kyai rdor/ bde mchog ste sngon gyi phyag len la dam rdzas bdun tshar/ yab rje'i sku thog la lcags khyi lo nas bzung chos skyong gi dam rdzas gtor ma rnams zor gtor du bsgyur bar mdzad nas dam rdzas glang ru ma gsum 'dug pa 'di gzhi bdag gtor ma yin na ni bral mthos gzhan 'bul yul gyi gsal kha ni med/ des na gtor bsngo chen mo'i gras la dur khrod bdag po yod cing / zor gtor gyi gras la med pas gtor ma 'di dur khrod bdag po la 'bul bzhed/ yin kyang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len ltar gtor ma bdun po de ka grangs kha mi 'tshams shing gad gtsang bas kho bos chu lug lo nas de bzhin bsgyur ba ltar dur khrod bdag po la bde mchog gtor ma'i smad ka 'bul lo/

/a mes zhabs kyi mdos chen pa dpon slob la gnang ba'i bka' shog las/ thugs dam nyi ma snga ma rnams kyi 'gros dang bstun zor las pa rnams kyi lho dang nub byang rnams su bskul dang bcas gtor ma 'phangs pa dang / ban tshang pa gzhon pa re mos kyi rkang thung 'bud par 'gro ba sogs sngar rgyun bzhin dang / zhes gsungs pas sngar gtor bzlog dngos gzhi shar la gnang ba de phyogs gzhan gsum la mgyogs gtor mdzad 'dra bas deng sang nub ma gtogs pa'i phyogs gsum la mgyogs gtor dgos sam snyam/ yang de nyid las bstod pa tshugs nas tshogs dpon zor las pa dang bcas pas 'khon bcug sbyang ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa brgya lhag tsam dang / de nas tshogs dpon dang mgon po'i gtor las pas yi ge bdun ma gtso bo dang / gzhan gtor las pa so so'i rang rang gi sngags rnams gtso bo dang / gzhan rnams 'phreng skor re tsam tshang 'grig re bzla ba/ yig brgya nas phur srung gi sngags kyi bar gtor bstod kyi bzlas pa'i skabs sgra ji bzhin dmigs pa rdo rje 'chang gi man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi drag po'i skabs de byed cing / tshogs chen gyis 'ur rgyag nges/ dkar mo ba'i bstod dbyangs tshugs su nye ba dang / tshogs dpon dang zor las pa rnams mig lta bsgrig nas spyir oṃ shrī mahā ka la sogs/ sngags gsum la dril bu chig brdung dang / de nas dril bu bcad stabs dang bcas sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i las mkhan gyi bstod pa bsdus pa grub pa yan dril bsil dang bcas byed cing / dkar mo man tshogs pa byings dang bstun nas byed ces dang / yang de nyid las bstod pa'i bar la gtor las pa so sos bzlas pa byed lugs zhal gyi des zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ring thung gang rigs/ pu tra'i des las mkhan gyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ba des shā sa na gtso bo dang lha mo'i sngags ring gang rigs/ bdud rgyal gyi des dkar bdud kyi sngags gnyis gtso bor bzla ba yin zhes sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung las thos pa lags pas kun gyi thugs la 'jug pa zhu zhes gsungs pas tshogs pa'i sngags dbyangs tshugs pa dang /

chog dpon zor las pa'i bzlas pa tshugs nas nyer gsum nas nyer drug gi bar la rab brjid dpa' bo'i dbyangs tshugs pa dang dril bsil gyi 'gor gur yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ lha mo'i ro ru/ zhal gyi sngags thung rnams brjod nas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/ /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod bar/ tshogs 'don ma rdzogs na cung zad sgug la dkar bstod nas mnyam 'don/ nyer bdun la mon bu bha ṭa nag po ni/ zhes dbyangs res tshugs pa dang / nyer brgyad la bdud rta bra nag tshogs nas sngags bstod dril bsil/ gong bzhin la dkar bdud bran bdud phur srung rnams kyi bstod pa'ang byed/ dam tshig mchod gtor sogs sangs rgyas bstan srung ma bsdus pa'i gras la yod/ 'phrin bcol ma byung kyang chog nyer dgu la bzlas pa byed rin mi chog pas bstod pa tshogs pa dang mnyam 'don byas nas a mes zhabs kyi dgongs pa dang mthun/ nyer dgu gtor rgyag gi nyin g.yul thang bar tshogs pa dang zor las pa lhan cig de nas sngon la phyin la smad zhing du gser skyems dpang gzugs/ drag bskul dus gsum rgyal ba ma/ zor lam dbye ba rnams pho nya bskul yan tshar ba byas nas/ pho nya bskul tshogs pa dang mnyam 'don grub pa dang mgyogs gtor gyi skabs bzhin so so'i sngags thun sngags bha ya rnams bzlas la/ mgon chen gyi des dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dza ti/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi rtsa brgyud kyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / khyad par bla ma mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen rnams kyi bka' bsgo gnyer gtad rjes su dran par mdzod la spyir bstan 'gro yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba byed pa thams cad dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud lha sde mi sde/

sbyin bdag sogs ltos par bcas pa thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs zhi bas mi thul ba thams cad lo zla ma 'gyangs pa thal ba'i rdul du rlogs la 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces dang / zhal gyi des dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum sring mo bzhi/ dregs pa pho bdun mo bdun/ srog gi sgo bdud nag po/ las kyi bshan pa nyer gcig zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde sogs bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs gong bzhin la/ mal lo'i tshab du gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes sbyar/ pu tra la/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum khams gsum srog gi gshed ma gshin rje pu tra gsung bdud kyi dbang phyug dam can bha ṭa/ sha za srog gcod kyi gtso mo gser gyi spu gri ma/ gdong gnyen gsang ba'i khro mo rnam bzhi/ sprul pa'i pho nya lnga/ stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa rgyud gsum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi sogs gong bzhin/ dkar bdud la snang srid ma mo'i bdag mo dkar mo nyi zla/ dregs byed yongs kyi ded dpon bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul thogs med bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shā na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi rtsa brgyud sogs gong bzhin la/ mal lo'i tshab 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ gzhan 'dra/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor la rgyal ba'i bka' bsrung dam pa dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ mkha' 'gro'i sde lnga/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bsgo gnyer gtad sogs gong bzhin brjod la 'phangs/

phod sne brdab la rang gi g.yon phyogs la kha bsgyur te rnga rol phyogs su blta ba dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi sogs brjod la rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa drwa bla bre gur me 'od rnams lam gyi gsal btab pa'i nang du rang nyid thun mtshams kyi he ru ka'i bskyed chog sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo rnams dang / tshigs chen bcu'i khro bo rnams lam gyis gsal btab la rkang rjes rdo rje rgya gram du lam lam byung bar mos shing / rakṣa dang tshe gzung bzla bas log de'i nub srod thun cig dang sang tho rengs rang gi nang du byas nas grol/ 'di skor gyi dmigs pa rnams sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyis dmar chen phyag deb du gsung ba bzhin la/ 'on kyang rang rang gi gtor ma dug dang mtshon cha me dpung yam rims nad kyi phung por gyur pas 'brub khung nang gi liṅgar 'phangs nas rnam shes spor dmigs dang / tshe bsod lhag ma rang la stim pa'i dmigs pa ni thams cad kyi bya'o// //ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bris/ bkra shis// //ces rnam 'dren kun blo'i zhal sgo las byon pa'i zor las pa'i yi ge 'di bzhin ma dpe shin tu dkon pa ma zad yod rigs kyang hrul song dbu shog med pa kho na byung bar brten/ sa byi dus mdos skabs 'khon rigs karma ratnas dbur mchod brjod shlau ka gcig gsar rtsom dang / de 'phro yas mas kyi tshig sdeb la zhib te cung zad zhal skongs su bris pa dge bas sa bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dus mdos zor las pa'i nyer mkho'i yi ge PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
